parameter_provenance.reduced_mass: Kamban and Pedersen, Scientific Reports 10, 5537 (2020), Table 1: MoSe2/WSe2 mu=0.2221 m0.
parameter_provenance.blk_formula: Kamban and Pedersen, Scientific Reports 10, 5537 (2020), Eq. (5).
parameter_provenance.hbn_kappa: Kamban and Pedersen (2020): effective hBN encapsulation kappa=4.945.
parameter_provenance.chi2d: Zhu et al., Phys. Rev. B 110, 155416 (2024), Table I: chi(MoSe2)=7.13 A, chi(WSe2)=5.56 A.
parameter_provenance.screening_conversion: r0=2*pi*chi2D in vacuum-length convention; chi in angstrom converted to nm.

mass_note: The present relative-coordinate Hamiltonian requires only reduced_mass_m0. Layer-resolved electron and hole masses are deliberately left null rather than invented.
geometry_note: Direct TMD contact with a natural van der Waals gap. hBN is external encapsulation, not a spacer. D is sensitivity-swept and is not yet a stacking-resolved ab-initio value.
notes: Material-specific BLK radial validation at D=0.55 nm; no hBN spacer.
